name: What’s the difference between a misdemeanor and a felony?

mainEntity.name: What’s the difference between a misdemeanor and a felony?

acceptedAnswer.text: Misdemeanors are considered less serious offenses, typically punished with fines or short jail time. Felonies carry harsher penalties, including longer jail sentences and loss of certain rights.angeloreyeslaw​
